title: ze_deadcore
description: A climb through four stages (A, B, C, D / Insane D) to the radiation core: block trains, cube mini bosses, dodge corridors, rising escapes, then the core's altar lasers, presses, beams, link lasers, balls and meteors.

fix-broken-movement-prediction.name: B ending speed boost
fix-broken-movement-prediction.summary: The B escape's 2x speed is CS2Fixes runspeed, not the map's laggy speed
fix-broken-movement-prediction.detail: At the B ending, b_escape_speedup1 doubles your speed for 36 s. The map does it with KeyValue speed 2 (lagged movement, which CS2 mispredicts: you stutter). GFL rewrites it to CS2Fixes' runspeed 2, a max-speed multiplier that predicts smoothly, then runspeed 1 36 s later. Off: the map's own speed 2 / speed 1.

scenarios.name: Stage A (full)
scenarios.summary: All of Stage A: holds, cubes, train, lift
scenarios.description: From the a_t1 teleport (des1) through the four holds (40/30/30/30 s) with three mini-boss cubes, the train boss and the lift. Win when a human reaches a_win_detecttrigger (a_nuke.Enable).

scenarios.name: Stage A boss: block train
scenarios.summary: Ride the train, dodge the sliding blocks
scenarios.description: a_boss_relay1: you ride a_boss_p1_train 14000 u west at 200 u/s (starts at +4 s, 70 s). Every 4.8 s a_boss_case1/2 slide one 570-unit block in from each side (a_boss_b1-6, 999999 damage) and pull the previous one back. Blocks are removed at +70 s.

scenarios.name: Stage B (full)
scenarios.summary: All of Stage B: holds, cube boss, poles
scenarios.description: From the b_t1 teleport through the holds, the cube boss (20 enemy4 kills or 112 s) and the pole escape. Win when a human reaches b_win_detecttrigger (b_nuke.Enable).

scenarios.name: Stage B boss: cube arena
scenarios.summary: Shoot down 20 chasing cubes, dodge floor attacks
scenarios.description: b_boss_relay1 (once b_p5, the bridge, has carried you over; it is removed at +4 s): three enemy4 cubes spawn at +5/6/7 s on the 2x6 grid (enemy4_maker1-12); each kill (1500 HP, no per-human scaling) spawns another and takes 1 off b_boss_counter1 (20). Cubes chase scanned humans and every 7 s stop and fire one of three floor patterns (2 s warning, 4 s of 40-damage hurt). The counter is forced to 0 at +112 s.

scenarios.name: Stage B escape: lift and poles
scenarios.summary: Ride the lift, dodge the pole waves
scenarios.description: b_boss_counter1 OnHitMin: the lift (b_escape_train) rises at +12 s, holds, b_escape_speedup sets speed 2 at +77 s while b_escape_pole_timer1 spawns pole waves every 1.35 s until +110 s; b_escape_push1 throws you up at +115.5 s. b_nuke at +130 s: be outside it.

scenarios.name: Stage C (full)
scenarios.summary: All of Stage C: crystals, corridor, escape
scenarios.description: From the c_t1 teleport: holds, 11 crystals (500 HP each) to break, the dodge corridor and the falling-block escape. Win at c_win_detecttrigger (c_nuke.Enable).

scenarios.name: Stage C boss: dodge corridor
scenarios.summary: Run the corridor through sweeping blocks
scenarios.description: c_escape_relay1 +60 s puts you at des1. From +65 s c_dodge_spawntimer1 (1 s) spawns one block from each of two rows (4 + 5 makers at y -12278); each rises then sweeps +y 9756 u at 1200 u/s with a 400-damage hurt. Reach c_dodge_trigger at y -11255 to stop the spawns.

scenarios.name: Stage C escape: rising platforms and blocks
scenarios.summary: Climb rising platforms through a block storm
scenarios.description: c_escape_relay1 +148 s: c_escape_timer1 spawns rising platforms every 1.29 s and from +152 s c_escape_block_timer1 fires one of 24 block makers every 0.2 s (0.1 s from +186 s): 128-unit blocks, 999999 damage, moving 6700 u at 2000 u/s. Spawns stop at +201/202 s.

scenarios.name: Stage D: the way to the core
scenarios.summary: Descend to the core: holds, meteors, radiation
scenarios.description: d_p1 lowers you 9000 u; d_relay1 then runs 210 s of holds and lifts (d_p2-d_p4, d_t2/d_t3 teleports) with four mini-boss cubes, d_meteor_detecttrigger meteors on every human and the 50-damage radiation floor (d_trigger). Ends when radiation_startrelay1 fires.

scenarios.name: Redcore (full Insane D)
scenarios.summary: Red map, 1 HP descent, insane core, escape
scenarios.description: The round after a win on D (d_win_detecttrigger OnUser1 -> level_counter 8 -> level_case OnCase09 -> stage_d_ex_relay). d_ex_relay (s_prelay1 +34.3 s) enables cc_red (deadcore.vpost, 20 s fade) and d_ex_hp_trigger.CountPlayersInZone 12 s in: every human outside the zone (all of you) is set to 90, 80 ... 1 HP over 18 s (d_ex_hp_filter). Four enemy2 cubes with 6500 HP on the way down; d_trigger_radiation's warp into the core sets 100 HP again. radiation_ex_startrelay1: the core on radiation_attackcase4 (10 segments of 300 + 56 x humans hits) and invert (deadcore_2.vpost) 12 s in; its death runs escape_relay_ex (faster lasers, meteors, the ex press). Win at d_nuke.Enable (+123 s).

scenarios.name: Insane D: the way to the core
scenarios.summary: The red descent: drained to 1 HP
scenarios.description: stage_d_ex_relay: as Stage D, but 12 s after d_ex_relay cc_red fades the map red (20 s) and d_ex_hp_trigger.CountPlayersInZone (game_zone_player) fires OnPlayerOutZone for every human outside its zone: d_ex_hp_filter (team 3) sets 90, 80 ... 1 HP over 18 s. The cubes are four enemy2 with 6500 HP. d_trigger_radiation's warp into the core sets 100 HP again. Ends when radiation_ex_startrelay1 fires.

scenarios.name: Radiation core (normal)
scenarios.summary: The radiation core boss, every attack
scenarios.description: 10 segments of 300 + 41 x humans hits (radiation_target OnHealthChanged -> radiation_hpcounter.Subtract 1; radiation_hptrigger adds 41 per human each segment). Attacks every 8-17 s: phase 1 (attackcase1), phase 2 after 3 segments, phase 3 after 6. Damageable from +25 s; at +164 s the timeover hurt (20) is enabled.

scenarios.name: Radiation core (Insane D)
scenarios.summary: The core boss on Insane: harder attacks, faster
scenarios.description: radiation_ex_startrelay1: 10 segments of 300 + 56 x humans hits (stage_d_ex_relay adds +15 per human), attacks from radiation_attackcase4 (laser2, press4, beam2, link4, ball_4, meteor4, huge meteor) every 4-15 s. The relay enables cc_red (red) at once and invert (deadcore_2.vpost, hues turned around) 12 s in, which stays on screen through the fight.

scenarios.name: Core: altar lasers (1 wave)
scenarios.summary: Jump the sweeping altar lasers
scenarios.description: 8 altars (radiation_laser_temp1-8) rise and sweep a 2620-wide, 200-tall laser (300 damage, 150 per touch) while the ring turns; speed ramps 1 -> 0 over 6 s. The laser hurts only from 9.2 to 9.4 s after its altar spawns: where it stopped.

scenarios.name: Core: altar lasers (2 waves)
scenarios.summary: Two waves of altar lasers, both ways
scenarios.description: As laser1 twice: second wave 2 s later in the other direction (radiation_laser_rotaterev). Each laser hurts only from 9.2 to 9.4 s after its altar spawns: where it stopped.

scenarios.name: Core: press (1 layer)
scenarios.summary: Find the gap in 1 press layer
scenarios.description: radiation_press1_core1 rises at 2000 u/s from +0.35 s; 1 of the 5 press patterns (radiation_press1_case1) spawn on it, their 999999-damage hurts are live from +6.95 s; it returns at 1200 u/s at +7 s.

scenarios.name: Core: press (2 layers)
scenarios.summary: Find the gap in 2 press layers
scenarios.description: radiation_press1_core1 rises at 2000 u/s from +0.35 s; 2 of the 5 press patterns (radiation_press1_case1) spawn on it, their 999999-damage hurts are live from +6.95 s; it returns at 1200 u/s at +7 s.

scenarios.name: Core: press (3 layers)
scenarios.summary: Find the gap in 3 press layers
scenarios.description: radiation_press1_core1 rises at 2000 u/s from +0.35 s; 3 of the 5 press patterns (radiation_press1_case1) spawn on it, their 999999-damage hurts are live from +6.95 s; it returns at 1200 u/s at +7 s.

scenarios.name: Core: press (4 layers)
scenarios.summary: Find the gap in 4 press layers
scenarios.description: radiation_press1_core1 rises at 2000 u/s from +0.35 s; 4 of the 5 press patterns (radiation_press1_case1) spawn on it, their 999999-damage hurts are live from +6.95 s; it returns at 1200 u/s at +8 s.

scenarios.name: Core: beams (slow)
scenarios.summary: Dodge a slow spray of spinning beams
scenarios.description: radiation_beam_timer1 spawns a beam every 0.2 s for 10 s from the spinning radiation_beam_rotate1 (440 deg/s); each beam opens left/right and travels for 2.7 s, 20 damage (10 per touch).

scenarios.name: Core: beams (fast)
scenarios.summary: Dodge a fast spray of spinning beams
scenarios.description: As beam1 with radiation_beam_timer2: a beam every 0.1 s.

scenarios.name: Core: link lasers 1
scenarios.summary: Jump the slow spinning link lasers
scenarios.description: radiation_link_basemove1 rises 1700 u; from +4 s two 2243-long link lasers (z +-152 around the link, 20 damage) spin (link rotate speed 0.33, base ramps to 1) until +14 s.

scenarios.name: Core: link lasers 2
scenarios.summary: Spinning link lasers, medium speed
scenarios.description: radiation_link_basemove1 rises 1700 u; from +4 s two 2243-long link lasers (z +-152 around the link, 20 damage) spin (link rotate speed 0.66, base ramps to 1) until +14 s.

scenarios.name: Core: link lasers 3
scenarios.summary: Spinning link lasers, medium speed
scenarios.description: radiation_link_basemove1 rises 1700 u; from +4 s two 2243-long link lasers (z +-152 around the link, 20 damage) spin (link rotate speed 0.66, base ramps to 1) until +14 s.

scenarios.name: Core: link lasers 4
scenarios.summary: Spinning link lasers, full speed
scenarios.description: radiation_link_basemove1 rises 1700 u; from +4 s two 2243-long link lasers (z +-152 around the link, 20 damage) spin (link rotate speed 1, base ramps to 1) until +14 s.

scenarios.name: Core: balls (1 wave)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the balls flying out, 1 wave
scenarios.description: All 16 radiation_ball_maker spawn a ball 1 time (1 s apart); each ball (100x100x140, 20 damage) flies out (func_door) and is closed back at +12 s.

scenarios.name: Core: balls (2 waves)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the balls flying out, 2 waves
scenarios.description: All 16 radiation_ball_maker spawn a ball 2 times (1 s apart); each ball (100x100x140, 20 damage) flies out (func_door) and is closed back at +12 s.

scenarios.name: Core: balls (3 waves)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the balls flying out, 3 waves
scenarios.description: All 16 radiation_ball_maker spawn a ball 3 times (1 s apart); each ball (100x100x140, 20 damage) flies out (func_door) and is closed back at +12 s.

scenarios.name: Core: balls (5 waves)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the balls flying out, 5 waves
scenarios.description: All 16 radiation_ball_maker spawn a ball 5 times (1 s apart); each ball (100x100x140, 20 damage) flies out (func_door) and is closed back at +12 s.

scenarios.name: Core: meteors on you (every 3.5 s)
scenarios.summary: Keep moving: a meteor on you every 3.5 s
scenarios.description: radiation_meteor_timer (3.5 s) pulses radiation_meteor_detecttrigger, which drops a meteor at each human (ForceSpawnAtEntityOrigin !activator): 3.8 s warning, then a 220x220x180 hurt for 0.1 s (100 damage, 50 per touch). Keep moving.

scenarios.name: Core: meteors on you (every 3 s)
scenarios.summary: Keep moving: a meteor on you every 3 s
scenarios.description: radiation_meteor_timer (3 s) pulses radiation_meteor_detecttrigger, which drops a meteor at each human (ForceSpawnAtEntityOrigin !activator): 3.8 s warning, then a 220x220x180 hurt for 0.1 s (100 damage, 50 per touch). Keep moving.

scenarios.name: Core: meteors on you (every 2.5 s)
scenarios.summary: Keep moving: a meteor on you every 2.5 s
scenarios.description: radiation_meteor_timer (2.5 s) pulses radiation_meteor_detecttrigger, which drops a meteor at each human (ForceSpawnAtEntityOrigin !activator): 3.8 s warning, then a 220x220x180 hurt for 0.1 s (100 damage, 50 per touch). Keep moving.

scenarios.name: Core: meteors on you (every 2 s)
scenarios.summary: Keep moving: a meteor on you every 2 s
scenarios.description: radiation_meteor_timer (2 s) pulses radiation_meteor_detecttrigger, which drops a meteor at each human (ForceSpawnAtEntityOrigin !activator): 3.8 s warning, then a 220x220x180 hurt for 0.1 s (100 damage, 50 per touch). Keep moving.

scenarios.name: Core: guard cubes
scenarios.summary: Break the guard cubes on the platforms
scenarios.description: radiation_guard_case1 picks red/green/blue: 3 s later all 8 radiation_enemyN_maker spawn that cube type on the 8 platforms (enemy1 chasers 1500 HP / enemy2 crosses 2400 HP / enemy3 slow fields 2000 HP). The next attack breaks them.

scenarios.name: Core: huge meteor (Insane)
scenarios.summary: Get off the two marked platforms
scenarios.description: radiation_hugemeteor_case1 picks 2 of the 8 platforms: the meteor drops on each and radiation_hugemeteor_hurt_platformN (1200x1200, 66 damage) is live from +8 to +9 s. Get off the marked platforms.

scenarios.name: Final escape (normal)
scenarios.summary: Final escape: beams, jump lasers, the press
scenarios.description: escape_common_relay: at +17 s escape_humantele puts you at (-5 -192 198). Beams (escape_beam_timer1, 7.5 s, 300 damage) from +44 s, platforms from +45 s, jump/duck lasers (escape_laser_timer1, 3.5 s, 300) from +52 s, the press at +92 s, final lasers (999999) at +108-110.6 s. d_win_detecttrigger opens at +120 s; d_nuke at +123 s.

scenarios.name: Final escape (Insane D)
scenarios.summary: Insane escape: faster lasers and meteors
scenarios.description: escape_relay_ex: lasers every 2.5 s, escape_ex_meteor_detecttrigger meteors from +21 s, escape_ex_press_relay at +92 s. cc_red and invert start on, as the core leaves them; 1 round in 6 the music case picks "prank D" (music_d_ex_escape_prankd: both off at +1.3 s, "Stage - D", "Just kidding", the relay turns them back on at +13 s, red on top). The last platform (escape_platform_move7) carries you 1800 u forward from +116.6 s, out of d_nuke (+123 s): be on it.

scenarios.name: Enemy1: chaser cube
scenarios.summary: A cube that hunts you down
scenarios.description: Stage A spot 1. A 1000-u radar beam (enemy1_filtertrigger1, 400 deg/s) tags a human (context target, 5 s) and wakes it; enemy1_triggerl/r/u/d (wait 0.3) fire the matching phys_thruster (1000, mass-independent) for 1 s toward tagged humans. Touching it: 50-damage hurt (25 per touch) plus four 300 u/s pushes up-and-out. Core 1500 HP, shootable once awake.

scenarios.name: Enemy2: cross laser cube
scenarios.summary: Crouch under a spinning laser cross
scenarios.description: Stage C spot 1. Wakes when a human enters its 1300x1300 box (enemy2_trigger1); 2.2 s later a 1300-long laser cross (2 x enemy2_hurt1, 40 damage, 20 per touch) spins at 50 deg/s around the core, 59 u above the floor: crouch under it. Core 2400 HP (6500 in Insane D).

scenarios.name: Enemy2 (Insane D): 6500 HP
scenarios.summary: The cross-laser cube with 6500 HP
scenarios.description: As enemy2 with d_ex_enemy_relay's SetHealth(6500).

scenarios.name: Enemy3: slow field cube
scenarios.summary: Kill the cube inside its slowing field
scenarios.description: Stage B spot 1. Wakes on its 1200x1200 box (enemy3_trigger1); from +2 s enemy3_timer1 pulses enemy3_slow1 (1200x1200x112) every 0.2 s: each touch sets speed 0.1, back to 1 over 2.6 s, so inside the field you crawl. Core 2000 HP.

scenarios.name: Enemy4: attack cube (Stage B boss)
scenarios.summary: A chasing cube with floor attacks
scenarios.description: One enemy4 at enemy4_maker1. Shootable at once (1500 HP). Radar tags humans; four thrusters (1100) chase. Every 7 s (enemy4_attack_timer1) it stops (DisableMotion) and one of 3 floor patterns (650x650) telegraphs for 2 s, then hurts for 4 s (40 damage, 20 per touch).
